remarks: Looking for a New York-style loft under 300K? Look no further! This second-floor condo is located in the historic Clocktower Close. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by an inviting open floor plan, featuring high ceilings and three large picture windows that flood the space with natural light and hardwood floors. The kitchen features a convenient kitchens-bar, electric range, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. A full bathroom is conveniently located on the main level.                                                                   Head up the stairs to discover a spacious bedroom with tall ceilings and exposed beams. Complete with a walk-in closet and a bonus space that can be used as your home office.  New water heater installed just 2.5 years ago.  This property is truly a commuter's dream, located just minutes away from Route 7, you'll have easy access to major highways and public transportation. Plus, enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to restaurants, shopping, and more. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
